newsitem.title: USA: INTERVIEW - Schein backs $1 bln 1997 revenue view.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Schein backs $1 bln 1997 revenue view.

text.p: Henry Schein Inc Chief Financial Officer Steven Paladino said the company is comfortable with Wall Street estimates of 1997 revenues of about $1 billion and 1996 revenues in the $820 million to $830 million range.
"Most estimates are right about $1 billion for 1997. We're comfortable with that," Paladino told Reuters at a Mesirow Financial dental conference here Thursday.

The mail-order dental, medical and veterinary products distributor also is comfortable with the First Call fourth-quarter earnings per share consensus estimate of $0.32, compared to $0.26 a year ago, Paladino said.
Schein also is comfortable with the 1997 earnings per share consensus forecast of $1.12, Paladino said.
The company had revenues in 1995 of $616.2 million.
Paladino said the company expects to report 1996 financial results on March 3.
